image_description: A high-angle shot of a wooden restaurant table featuring two plates of food (one with sushi rolls, one with fried appetizers), a glass of dark liquid, and several paper menus. One menu is open in the center background, another is closed on the left, and a red promotional stand-up menu is visible on the right edge. Partial views of two people are present at the top corners.

artifact_observations.location: Red menu on right edge and green bottle label on left
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the red menu and the green bottle label is nonsensical and distorted, characteristic of AI generation failing to render coherent typography.
The sushi rolls lack distinct structural definition; fillings and rice blend together unnaturally, appearing slightly melted or fused.
The elliptical shape of the glass rim is slightly irregular and wobbly, not forming a smooth geometric curve.
The texture of the fried items is overly uniform and 'smudged,' lacking the crisp, individual detail expected of fried batter.

focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on menus and labels
Structural integrity of food items (sushi and fried goods)

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text_gibberish artifact. In real images, out-of-focus text blurs but retains linearity; AI-generated text often warps or becomes symbol-like. Verify if the 'sushi' has distinct layers or if it's a textured blob. Check if the glass rim is a perfect ellipse.
